##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind later.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure to the southwest of Ireland.


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south at first, backing north or northeast later this afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 this evening, then north 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate in the south at first, becoming smooth or slight this afternoon, then slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, backing northwest 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
